soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles dark brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.61–0.65, lateral margins roughly parallel and slightly widening posteriorly, posterior margin an even arc. Frontal peaks slightly raised, slightly concave between the peaks. Labrum ligulate, apex broad and rounded, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all present. Mandibles slightly stout at the apex, curved and slightly upturned; length about 0.51–0.56 times head capsule length and 0.81–0.87 times head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Widest part of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal; waist region rather broad with parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.38–0.48. Pronotum kidney-shaped, 1.6–1.7 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle; more than 10 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
